content.text:
Built a complete 3D Halloween chase game in `index.html`. Collect all 8 candies from glowing porches, evade the Hollow, then reach the lit gate.

- **Desktop:** WASD to move, Shift to sprint, mouse to look.
- **Touchscreens:** Use the on-screen joystick and HURRY button.
- **Assumption:** I made the pursuer a fictional folklore shadow creature rather than tying a monster to a real-world religious group.

I checked the game in a browser; the scene rendered and movement worked.
